description: #[non_exhaustive] on ValidatedPath (pkix-path/src/lib.rs) prevents external code from constructing the struct or matching it exhaustively. This is the correct choice: anchor_index and depth are obviously the first fields, but future fields (selected policy, chain signature algorithms, etc.) should be addable in minor versions. A contributor who sees the struct might suggest removing #[non_exhaustive] because the fields are pub — the answer is that the two serve different purposes.
title: ValidatedPath is #[non_exhaustive] — future fields can be added without a breaking change
